Definition: from G2596 and G4972; to seal closely:--seal.
BiblicalUsage: I saw in the right hand of Him that sat on the throne a book written within and on the backside, sealed with seven seals.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the sealed book is God's plan held shut until the Lamb is found worthy to open it.
